description: ignorePaths replaces (not merges) the preset value, so the :ignoreModulesAndTests defaults are restated before the repo-specific entry. Root package.json is the legacy 2015 app (reference only, never installed); the live Worker manifest is worker/package.json. ignorePaths, not packageRules.enabled=false, because vulnerabilityAlerts overlay packageRules and would keep raising security PRs.
